about.title: About Jonathan Wyman, CPA
text: We are a full-service Accounting firm licensed in TX. We offer a broad range of services for business owners, executives, and independent professionals. We are affordable, experienced, and friendly.

Jonathan Wyman is a Certified Public Accountant and a QuickBooks Pro Advisor. He has a broad range of experience in tax planning and tax preparation for individuals and businesses, both foreign and domestic, including real estate, retail, restaurants, high tech industry, physicians, lawyers, nurses, dentists, engineers, hair stylists, advertising agencies, non-profits, oil and gas, trucking, and more.

Jonathan’s wife, Laura, is a Texas native, and together, they have five young children. He has served as treasurer for a non-profit organization and as a public-school volunteer. In his free time, Jonathan enjoys reading, running, and spending time with his family.
